newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM plans DFl 1 bn investment ex takeovers.
newsitem.headline: DSM plans DFl 1 bn investment ex takeovers.

text.p: Dutch chemicals giant DSM NV said on Tuesday it expected to invest around one billion guilders in 1997, excluding acquisitions.
"In terms of the investments for 1997, we are currently expecting a level of around one billion guilders," DSM chairman Simon de Bree told a results news conference.
"If there are acquisitions, then that will come on top of that (sum)," he added.
De Bree said DSM would continue to diversify into less cyclical sectors such as fine chemicals through acquisitions, alliances and joint ventures, but also independent investment.
In 1996 the company invested 1.64 billion guilders in fixed assets and acquistions, almost double that of 1995.
